response.summary: Overall, the notebook runs end-to-end and reports metrics consistently, but the modeling quality is not acceptable because the evaluation is invalid. The key issue is a critical data leakage: a “risk_score” feature is built using the target variable (churned), which makes any performance numbers unreliable. There is also a major mismatch between the written conclusion (claims AUC 0.99) and the actual printed test result (AUC 0.858), suggesting weak result validation and reporting. In the interview, verify whether the candidate understands target leakage, can explain how to prevent it (feature design and proper train/test separation), and can reconcile conclusions with computed outputs.
